predecessors.name: Ilkhanate
predecessors.text: the region of Elbistan, where Zayn al-Din Qaraja established himself in 1335 and took the town in 1337

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: the whole beylik, made a sanjak under Ali Bey

ledger.x: 1337: Zayn al-Din Qaraja takes Elbistan and founds the Dulkadir beylik.
1485: Bozkurt attacks Malatya, opening the Ottoman-Mamluk war for Dulkadir.
May 1491: peace ends the Ottoman-Mamluk war.
1507: the seat moves from Elbistan to Marash (infobox 'Elbistan (1337-1507); Marash (1507-1522)').
13 June 1515: Selim I destroys Dulkadir at Turnadag.

wars.name: Mamluk expedition against Shah Suwar
wars.outcome: 'Shah Suwar was defeated in 1471 by a Mamluk expedition led by Qaitbay's top field commander, Yashbak min Mahdi'; Shah Suwar was the Dulkadirid ruler the Ottomans backed.

wars.name: Ottoman-Mamluk War (1485-1491)
wars.outcome: Bozkurt's attack on Malatya opened the war; Dulkadir forces supported the Ottoman army in 1487 and the Dulkadirids appear on both sides after 1488; peace in May 1491 left the boundaries essentially unchanged.

wars.name: Battle of Turnadag
wars.outcome: The Ottomans under Selim I defeated Bozkurt on 13 June 1515 near Goksun; Bozkurt and his sons were killed and the beylik became an Ottoman sanjak.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line except the 1491 Ottoman-Mamluk treaty, which left the boundaries 'essentially unchanged' without describing them; the Taurus and Anti-Taurus frontiers are approximate.
